shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g 'AGENTS.md' -g 'package.json' -g '*lock*' -g 'src/**' -g 'app/**' -g 'pages/**' -g 'index.html' -g '*config*' -g 'README*' -g 'public/**' -g 'components/**'"
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -la && cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/index.css && cat src/main.tsx && cat vite.config.ts'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/uikit @gravity-ui/icons'
/bin/bash -lc "find .. -name AGENTS.md -not -path '*/node_modules/*' -not -path '*/.git/*'; cat tsconfig.json; cat index.html; git status --short"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | head -65; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider/ThemeProvider.d.ts; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/; rg 'Eye|ArrowRight|Lock|CircleQuestion|Envelope|ArrowUpRight' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/esm/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Checkbox/Checkbox.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build | rg '(TextInput.*d.ts|Provider.*d.ts|docs/INDEX|Button.d.ts|Modal.d.ts)"'$'"'; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/Provider/Provider.d.ts; rg 'Eye|ArrowRight|Lock|CircleQuestion|Envelope|ArrowUpRight|ShieldCheck|Shapes3' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build/esm/index.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/Provider.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | head -45; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Modal/Modal.d.ts; rg --files node_modules | rg 'playwright|puppeteer' | head"
/bin/bash -lc "rg 'export.*(Eye|ArrowRight|Lock|CircleQuestion|Envelope|ArrowUpRight|ShieldCheck|Check|ArrowRightToSquare)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.css | head -80; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/types.d.ts | head -100; git diff --stat'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install --prefix /tmp/gravity-browser-check @playwright/test'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0'
/bin/bash -lc '/tmp/gravity-browser-check/node_modules/.bin/playwright install chromium'
/bin/bash -lc 'npx --yes prettier --write src/App.tsx src/main.tsx src/index.css index.html'

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'invalid|error|focus-outline' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.css; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/fonts.css | head -35; rg -n 'type:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.js"
/bin/bash -lc 'which apt-get; which sudo; ls /tmp; printenv LD_LIBRARY_PATH; ls /usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libglib*'
/bin/bash -lc 'id; /tmp/gravity-browser-check/node_modules/.bin/playwright install-deps chromium'
/bin/bash -lc "ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1254/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell | rg 'not found'; ls /var/lib/apt/lists | head"

/bin/bash -lc 'mkdir -p /tmp/gravity-browser-libs && cd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs && apt-get download libglib2.0-0 libnspr4 libnss3 libatk1.0-0 libdbus-1-3 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxfixes3 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxkbcommon0 libasound2 libatspi2.0-0 libdrm2 libexpat1 libx11-xcb1 && for package in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" extracted; done'

/bin/bash -lc "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1254/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell | rg 'not found'; cd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs && apt-get download libxrender1 libwayland-server0 && for package in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x \""'$package" extracted; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs && apt-get download libxi6 && dpkg-deb -x libxi6*.deb extracted'

/bin/bash -lc "cd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs && apt-get download fonts-liberation && dpkg-deb -x fonts-liberation*.deb extracted && cat > fonts.conf <<'EOF'
<?xml version=\"1.0\"?><"'!DOCTYPE fontconfig SYSTEM "urn:fontconfig:fonts.dtd"><fontconfig><dir>/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/share/fonts</dir><cachedir>/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/fontcache</cachedir></fontconfig>
EOF'

/bin/bash -lc "ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium_headless_shell-1254/chrome-headless-shell-linux-arm64/chrome-headless-shell | rg 'font|freetype'; cd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs && apt-get download libfontconfig1 libfreetype6 && for package in libfontconfig*.deb libfreetype*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x \""'$package" extracted; done'

/bin/bash -lc "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1254/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found'; cd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs && apt-get download libatk-bridge2.0-0 libcups2 libpango-1.0-0 libcairo2 libharfbuzz0b libthai0 libdatrie1 libgraphite2-3 libpixman-1-0 libxcb-render0 libxcb-shm0 && for package in *.deb; do dpkg-deb -x \""'$package" extracted; done'

/bin/bash -lc "LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /home/node/.cache/ms-playwright/chromium-1254/chrome-linux-arm64/chrome | rg 'not found'; cd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs && apt-get download libavahi-common3 libavahi-client3 && for package in libavahi*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x \""'$package" extracted; done'
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs && apt-get download libpng16-16 libfribidi0 && for package in libpng*.deb libfribidi*.deb; do dpkg-deb -x "$package" extracted; done'

/bin/bash -lc 'LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu:/tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu ldd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/libsoftokn3.so; ls /tmp/gravity-browser-libs/extracted/usr/lib/aarch64-linux-gnu/*nss*'
/bin/bash -lc 'cd /tmp/gravity-browser-libs && apt-get download libsqlite3-0 && dpkg-deb -x libsqlite*.deb extracted'
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check'
/bin/bash -lc 'ls -l /tmp/gravity-browser-libs/libsqlite*; cat package.json; git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc "rg 'export.*(Globe|Sparkles)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts; cat .gitignore; rg -n 'sparkle|language|submit-button' src/App.tsx src/index.css"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm run build && git diff --check && git status --short'
